contract_kind: canonical runtime-reference contract (extracted from existing canon; no second messaging contract proposed)

invariants.name: MessageEnvelope / storage shape
invariants.statement: channel_messages carries kind, message_family, audience_json, body_json (discriminated union, validated on write), refs_json, work_refs_json, evidence_refs_json, forensic_event_ids_json, provenance_json; delivery cursor is table-wide autoincrement id; seq is per-channel display ordinal only.

invariants.name: Audience is the canonical addressing model
invariants.statement: audience = {visibility, action_targets[], suggested_watchers[], scope_refs[], urgency}; target_key/target_job_id are 0.1 bridge aliases for action_targets[0].

invariants.name: Visibility enum governs awareness only
invariants.statement: private | targets | chain | node | operator | public_audit; per-kind defaults with container default chain/node; visibility filters awareness/card only, never authority and never automatic evidence dereference.

invariants.name: action_targets wake; suggested_watchers never do
invariants.statement: action_targets may be auto-woken through the scheduler; suggested_watchers widen awareness (card/pointer) only.

invariants.name: Routing hard / attention soft / authority hard
invariants.statement: A non-matching message is not auto-wake but remains noticable via the progress projection and actionable through attention_policy requests; noticing is never activation; activation authority stays with coordinator/judge/scheduler.

invariants.name: read != ack
invariants.statement: readSince is pure observation and never advances any cursor; markSeen(processedId) is the only cursor advance.

invariants.name: delivered != processed (cursor-through-N)
invariants.statement: Cursor advances to the highest successfully processed message id only; a failed enqueue does not advance it; at-least-once delivery with receiver-side dedupe by (channel_id, msg_id).

invariants.name: body != authority
invariants.statement: Authority is verified against DB participant state, spec emits/cannot_emit, capability scope, refs, provenance — never body text; a body claiming role/identity is downgraded to kind=note with no wakeup; unknown authority = reject.

invariants.name: Distinct rejection outcome classes
invariants.statement: validation-reject, authority-reject, note-downgrade are distinct facts; rejects are not written as requested kind but always produce a runtime.message_rejected audit record and the structured §10.2 error envelope.

invariants.name: Participant L3 vs activation/job L4
invariants.statement: participant_id (L3, stable member identity in scope) is used for subscriptions/addressing/authority checks; job_id (L4, current activation) changes on respawn/resume; channel authority checks participant_id + current job_id; scheduler resolves L3→L4; identity is minted by substrate, channels only consume.
invariants.owner: channels.md §5.1 identity table; substrate_design_it.md §2.7 owns the model

invariants.name: Pointer-first evidence
invariants.statement: Participants receive pointers/cards by default; full evidence dereferenced only under the six-condition requestEvidence gate (valid activation, visibility or operator override, addressing/subscription/step-contract/scope-overlap, can_request_evidence, cap/cooldown/dedup, grant for out-of-contract scope); durable grants live in substrate-owned evidence_access_grants.

invariants.name: work_refs are the graph-derivation input
invariants.statement: {author_issue_id, target_issue_ids[], spawned_issue_ids[], relation_hints[]} supplied by the author at post(); the edge deriver is a pure function of (kind, proposal_class, verdict, work_refs, scope_refs, evidence_refs, forensic_event_ids) and never parses free-text body.

invariants.name: Forensic/evidence dual write
invariants.statement: Significant mutations dual-write xtrm.forensic.v1 events via the shared envelope writer (channel.* mechanical family); verdicts/findings additionally dual-write durable evidence; after-hook order is forensic → evidence → edge → projection, each idempotent by its own key.

invariants.name: Edges are descriptive, triple-linked, degrade-not-reject
invariants.statement: Every edge links source message + forensic event (evidence only for evidence-producing messages); edges never grant authority; endpoint mismatch degrades to provenance endpoint_status=unverified_endpoint, never a message rejection.

invariants.name: Scheduler indirection (intent, never direct resume)
invariants.statement: Every channel read emits a resume intent consumed by a scheduler — trivial 1:1 for chains/pairs, node-supervisor inbox for nodes; built in 0.1 even where the scheduler is trivial so 0.2 needs no rewiring.

invariants.name: Single-scheduler invariant
invariants.statement: One scheduler per channel kind; node members never wake from a channel bypassing node-supervisor; enforced by test in 0.2 (direct channel→runner wake inside a node is a test failure). Prevents the unitAI-jzhim split-brain.

invariants.name: Progress projection is recomputable cache owned by substrate
invariants.statement: Truth is the stream; container_progress is an event-sourced cache computed by the runtime after-hook (not the coordinator), joined from stream + edges + issue state + runtime status; two renderings (visibility-filtered ambient card pushed on wake; rich coordinator projection pulled); watermark last_message_id enables recompute-if-behind.

invariants.name: Reducer purity / after-hook split
invariants.statement: Reducer derives state purely (no I/O, replay-safe); all effects (resume intents, system.* writes, dual-writes, edges, projection updates) live in the after-hook gated on idempotency keys listed in §5.5.

invariants.name: Attention/self-activation are requests, never self-grants
invariants.statement: Two rungs both requests: rung 1 control.attention_requested (soft), rung 2 work.proposal{self_activation} (firm, derives discovered_from + requests_attention edges); activation always adjudicated via system.redirect/scheduler; gated by attention_policy.can_self_activate_on, self_activation_mode off|attention|proposal, per-epoch caps (2/1), cooldown, dedup; epoch resets only on system.epoch_bump.

invariants.name: Declarative stop conditions, first to fire wins
invariants.statement: judge.done | consensus:N | budget:tokens=T | budget:turns=N | idle:K | judge_timeout:N (auto system.continue backstop; judge is eventually-consistent, never blocking) | manual; evaluated after every message write.

invariants.name: Status separate from drain
invariants.statement: open → draining → closed | aborted; draining stops new actionable writes but permits reading/acking outstanding messages; pruning excludes open/draining channels.

invariants.name: work.verdict is single-target
invariants.statement: Validator requires exactly one action_target and one target issue per verdict; N executors produce N verdict messages; edge derivation fans one edge per target.

invariants.name: system.swap unsubscribes, never kills
invariants.statement: Producer ordering pins steps 1–5 before epoch_bump; dirty writer lease blocks swap completion; edits preserved; only explicit operator sp stop kills; takeover audited (checkpoint/commit/stash/takeover-dirty).

invariants.name: Durable grant authority is substrate DB state
invariants.statement: evidence_access_grants row (substrate-owned) is the authority; forensics audit request/grant/deny/dereference/revoke but never authorize; grants must expire; operator_override is a DB flag, never a body assertion.

invariants.name: runtime.* mechanical failure kinds + chain.incident.* wake
invariants.statement: Reducer detects intra-run mechanical failures (participant_died, gate_unresponsive, worktree_diverged, evidence_ref_broken, pulse_delivery_failed, budget_exhausted_mid_step, recursion_cap), attempts deterministic recovery, then emits chain.incident.opened as the coordinator's only explicit wake; detection stays in reducer, wake intent in after-hook; closed:failed is always a coordinator verdict, never runtime fallthrough.
invariants.owner: substrate IT §3.1 invariant + §4.3 role 5 (xtrm-1jp); plain_it carries the message-kind delta

deferred_by_design: cross-channel watching / epic-level channel (out of scope indefinitely; cross-container coordination belongs to pulse)
multi-user identity in messages (single user author key)
notes: All 11 canonical open questions resolved (channels.md §12). The contract above is extracted solely from existing canon; no second messaging contract is proposed.
